name: Okudera Anna
source:
The married woman living in Room 601, next door to Yuuto. Once a glamorous dyed blonde gal, she is now an intellectual beauty who suits her glasses.

True to her prim and proper appearance, she's an education-focused mom with the look of a true intellectual. Her husband runs a video production company, and she often helps out with his work.

When Yuuto asks, “What kind of work is that?”, she just gives him a bewitching smile and doesn't answer.

She's a graduate of St. Marian Academy, widely known by its nickname “Yariman Academy”.

At school, she wore the mask of a serious student council president, but after classes, she was wildly active as a sugar baby high school girl who loved older men. 

Now she appears to be a education-focused beauty, but before marriage, she was the top-ranked awahime at a soapland, and she starred in "educational" films teaching youth about men and women.

She wasn't particularly strapped for cash; she simply adored that line of work. It was through that line of work that she met her current husband and ended up marrying him.

The birth of her beloved only daughter, Sachiho, prompted her to become more serious, choosing to prioritize her role as a mother over her identity as a woman.

Yet she understands that the blood of debauchery ingrained in her youth still simmers and boils deep within her body.

[From [url=http://www.orcsoft.jp/zom002/character.html]official site[/url]]
